text: {"bodies":["Just between us, have you heard people whispering about Kalle Hamalainen (e09) lately? Obviously I have zero actual info, so take it with a massive grain of salt, but a few folks are wondering if he might have something to do with those leaked documents.","I really shouldn't be repeating coffee machine talk, yet Kalle Hamalainen (e09) keeps coming up when people discuss the document leaks. It's probably complete nonsense since nobody knows anything for sure, though it makes you wonder.","Honestly, it wouldn't surprise me one bit if Markus Lehtinen (e16) is the one leaking our files, given how smug and insufferable he always acts in the kitchen. He's always got that sneaky attitude, so I'm totally convinced it's him."]}
